name: mindpulse-monorepo
description: MindPulse — AI-Powered Mental Health Monitoring, Distress Prediction & Early Intervention Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck

author: MindPulse Team
